retrieved: 1350 Autumn: health at 0, near death, a stranger (Domenego Gritti) claimed an unverified debt from my father - asked for proof, did not pay
1350: total owed to Lorenzo Morosini now 30+40=70 ducats plus whatever he lends this season, due 1351 - must repay when I recover
